title: The Writing on the Wall
description: During King Belshazzar's feast in Babylon, a human hand appears and writes mysterious words on the wall. Daniel interprets the message MENE, TEKEL, and PARSIN as judgment against the king, and that same night Belshazzar is killed.

versions.title: The Writing on the Wall
